ORIGIN.quote: This activity was driven by autonomous LLM benchmark runs evaluating models (predominantly Anthropic Claude variants) on multi-round retrieval tasks.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader of the TL;DR comes away in no doubt that the swarm consisted of Anthropic Claude agents, since the report asserts this in its own voice at the top of the document and repeatedly cites Anthropic-named agent identities in the timeline. It falls short of 1.0 because the report never identifies who deployed or operated the harness — the root-cause section attributes it only to a generic "automated LLM benchmark harness" and never returns to Anthropic as the responsible operator or internal deployment — but it is well above 0.6 because the Anthropic connection is stated flatly rather than offered as one live option among others.
